'''Newington Football Club''' (previously known as '''Newington Youth Club''') is a semi-professional Northern Irish football club playing in [[NIFL Championship]]. The club originates from the [[Newington, Belfast|Newington]] area of [[Belfast]] and ground shares with [[NIFL Premiership]] side [[Cliftonville F.C.]]."}}
